acceptanceTests.scenario: Open chooser, type น้ำท่วม; five flood-related records appear, including a separately labelled dated Hat Yai archive; clear restores the previous pillar filter.

Search flood in Thai mode and น้ำท่วม in English mode; both return the same five IDs, grouped by semantics. Search traffic also finds the retained Traffic Incident alias for Events & Notices, without changing its broader title.
Search a no-match string; status says no matching names, offers clear; selected record and map remain unchanged.
Open with keyboard, reach search, filters, preview button and real link; Escape returns focus to opener and does not change selection. Focus remains inside modal.
Preview DWR forecast, Google flash flood and Hat Yai archive; each keeps provider, horizon or event dates and its limitation. No generic live badge is added.
Prototype selecting a preview changes only the local summary; external map opens only through its explicit link. No data API requests, login or permissions are simulated.
All 43 IDs appear once; counts 13/16/14; hidden businessDynamics absent in search, list and counts. Two archives count as catalog resources, not new data feeds.
At widths 320, 390 and 1280 CSS px, both languages and 200% text zoom: long names wrap, no clipped provider/date, all actions >=44px, no horizontal scroll or coloured selection rail.
Curated building/deed 3D or named-area links remain byte-for-byte catalog URLs; terrain opens its 3D URL; language switching does not append an unsupported lang=en to maps.
Operational integration only: rapid A→B selection plus delayed A response leaves B selected and painted; failures keep previous valid view and a visible retry; no stale source/period labels.
Native screen-reader check reads dialog name, selected state, result count and descriptive external links; no menu/tree/listbox role is applied to this list.
Check source date unavailable vs measured zero: prototype says read the available period on the map and never invents a timestamp or completeness claim.
